name: Dorr Clark
role: Owner of the VVV outfit; manager of Clark & Plum
bio: Dorr Clark owned the VVV outfit and half of the E6 brand, and was listed as manager of Clark & Plum, with an office at 110 Dearborn Street, Chicago. In June 1884 he came to Medora to receive two hundred Short-horn bulls and partly arranged to sell a large number of cattle to the company, saying he had about 10,000 for sale. In September 1884 he reported sick cattle among late through herds but said stockmen had them quarantined. Most of his appearances are his name on a $250 reward notice against setting grass fires printed from June 1884 into early 1885.
